supersededOpenCounselQuestion.question: Which record governs the notarised verification on a Sec. 99-19-71(4) petition: the specification, which makes the jurat mandatory and calls the packet not filing-ready without it, or the legal-design intake memo, which records notarization as unresolved and prints a simple truth statement?
supersededOpenCounselQuestion.treatmentAtTheTime: It does not resolve it. No verification block and no notarial certificate was added to the petition, the order or the certificate of service. The cover's signing-and-notarization page prints the SPECIFICATION's wording verbatim, because the specification is the server-owned document for this page, says on the page that it is printed from the specification, states that the composed petition carries a truth statement instead, and sends the participant to the records office of the court that heard the case - which is what the filing instructions already do.
supersededOpenCounselQuestion.retiredBecause: Settled before this correction and no longer true of the delivered packet. The track registry records rules.notarization as Required, carrying the specification MS-nonconviction-expungement-99-19-71-4 (specificationVersion 2.0.0, notarisationRequired true) and Roger Roman's direction of 2026-09-03 (SHA-256 88497978c1411950ea3977a7ae32087e29fc375017cadc87b20d700c60623866) as the controlling inputs, with the memo's unresolved note expressly not permission to omit it. FIX107 implemented it: the VERIFICATION section renders on its own sheet under the petition's caption in both fixtures, body and jurat verbatim, with the jurat date and all seven notarial fields left blank for the actual acts. The retired treatment sentence — that no verification block and no notarial certificate was added — is false of delivered page 5.

censusV1Representation.notarisationTreatment: The petition carries the specification's VERIFICATION section: a verification on oath with a jurat, rendered on its own sheet. LegalEase does not administer the oath, does not date the jurat and does not complete any notarial field; those are the notary's and the participant's acts and are left blank. This records what the packet delivers. It is not a ruling that Miss. Code Ann. Sec. 99-19-71(4) itself compels notarisation, and it is not counsel approval.
